items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: we had a little group called the Newport Jazz Festival All Stars, which was Ruby Braff... Pee Wee Russell, clarinet, George played the piano... And we played -- did a lot of dates around the States

ctx.x: As most of your musical contemporaries, most of the musicians weren't into anything else.

No, I want to say particularly if I may, that I have tremendous respect for Jack Teagarden and there was a story about him that -- I remember that I was playing with the Pollack band, in New York, and Glenn Miller had given his notice and so Ben said & well, we will be looking for another trombone player to take Glenn's place, and I got a call about 3:00 one morning, one of our nights off and the call was from Pee Wee Russell, and he said, <Bud, about the greatest jazz trombone player in the world is blowing into…

So I went over to hear this great player and Pee Wee was at the bar and we waited about a half hour and there appeared at the door, the speakeasy door, a man with a little cap, a button cap, a corduroy Norfolk suit, shoes -- trousers halfway up his legs -- I can't remember the shoes now -- but anyway, I think they were suede shoes and he had a trombone, not in a case, but in a little velvet bag. He took it out of the bag, put it together and played with no accompaniment, some of the finest music I ever have heard…

items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: we used the Condon, Pete and Russell, group: Pee Wee Max Kaminsky, Eddie himself

ctx.x: And when you think of that alone, or even if it had only been fifteen years, that is still a long time, still way ahead of his... And I think that when you suggested earlier that there isn't enough said about Dave, I certainly must agree with that, that I would like to suggest that fans go back to an album that Dave and I made, it's called from -- I think it's called From Austin High Comes Jazz or simply called Comes Jazz, and we used the Condon, Pete and Russell, group: Pee Wee Max Kaminsky, Eddie himself, we…
